author: Emmaye
body:
JonVillegas has been Consistently combat logging lately, and I managed to get a picture of him as a Spectator who killed me, right after I died I did /list instantly, which means he void logged on me, as we knocked each other both in the void. He doesn't seem to show up on the spectator list. Then I went to check to see if he was on avicus, but he wasn't online at all. I was wondering if this was enough proof to get him punished, it annoys me when people do this to me.
I mean look at his KDR, its a 15 or so :/
